panels.title: Big questions
points: Where does the energy in your breakfast originally come from?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah says: 'It is He who sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby the growth of all things, and We produce from it greenery' (al-An'am 6:99). Photosynthesis is how that greenery turns light into food.
